name: MultiQure S.A.
summary: MultiQure S.A., a biopharmaceutical company, engages in the research and development of biological drugs and medical devices for therapeutic use. Its therapeutic portfolio in the field of immuno-oncology includes PB003G, which targets the GARP-TGFß1 complex; PB004, an anticancer drug based on an anti-ROR1 antibody; and PB003A, a therapy that targets the aVß8 integrin. The company was formerly known as Pure Biologics S.A. and changed its name to MultiQure S.A. in August 2026. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Wroclaw, Poland.
